title: How to Handle "We Have No Budget": Objection Handling and Sales Scripts for Founders and SDRs
summary:
"We have no budget" is the objection that ends more sales calls than any other. Good objection handling starts with one idea: it is almost never a statement about money. It is a statement about priority, risk or authority. If you treat it as a fact, you leave. If you treat it as information, you get a next step.
This post gives you a way to diagnose which "no budget" you are hearing, plus sales scripts you can practise out loud. It works for founder-led sales, SDRs and account executives alike.
